**Cover Letter Draft**

Subject: Application for AI Engineer (Ai Developer) – [Your Name]

Dear Liquid Thought Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the AI Engineer (Ai Developer) position in Cape Town, as advertised. With a strong background in AI and systems engineering, I am eager to contribute to building and deploying production AI solutions for your client platforms.

My expertise spans Python, TypeScript, LLMs, RAG, and agent-based systems, complemented by experience in .NET and distributed systems. I have a proven track record in developing and implementing AI solutions that drive automated workflows, personalisation, and intelligent assistance, directly aligning with the core responsibilities of this role.

My work on projects like the Mercatus Assist / THINK demo has provided me with practical experience in bringing advanced AI capabilities into production environments. I am confident that my skills and passion for creating impactful AI solutions would be a valuable asset to Liquid Thought.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
[Your Contact Information]

**Fit Notes**

*   The role's focus on LLM-powered assistants, automated workflows, and personalisation perfectly matches your stated "why."
